run_debug_draw_simulation: run a pybullet simulation that loads a KUKA robot and draws debug lines and text on its end effector
create_debug_text_on_robot_link: create debug text overlaid on a specific robot link using addUserDebugText with a parent object and link index
create_debug_lines_on_robot_link: create colored debug lines attached to a robot link using addUserDebugLine with a parent object and link index
load_urdf_robot_model: load a URDF robot model into the pybullet simulator using loadURDF and return its body unique ID
reset_robot_joint_state: reset a robot joint to a specific angle using resetJointState with the body ID, joint index, and target angle
